question: Under what temporal condition of practice are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: A duration of one year is given.
The condition is that practice has been done when that duration applies.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The continuity or regularity of practice required is not specified here.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
